conclusions: Source ae2256d adds a component-only comparison of eight cooperative scalar-float QK layouts and the retained single-lane scalar-float control. Each uses the original integer K16 carry, exact float products and existing fallback. Production dispatch is unchanged.

All 171 generated cases match 292498128 raw score slots, with 1216 independent CPU dots per variant. All nine variants match 418496528 captured real score slots and 228 CPU dots each. Causal tails, padded key strides, partial tiles, cancellation and ineligible operand fallback pass, along with guards and immutable inputs.

In the same executable, original integer QK is 453.4480 ms, retained scalar float is 344.6427 ms, and the fastest new cooperative variant (4 lanes, 4 staged groups, 8 queries by 8 keys) is 491.0003 ms. Other cooperative variants range from 504.0208 to 1422.5174 ms except the 4-lane 1-group 8-query variant at 510.1393 ms. None improves the retained scalar control. Key transpose is common at 5.7831 ms.

Keep the measured cooperative layouts outside product dispatch. Current correctness-attached product settings remain registered MoE metadata 1, whole/MoE prevalidated float 1 and CK scalar float QK 1. Investigate broader linear-attention exact-matrix work next.
limitations: These are single component observations with allocation, uploads and comparison outside timed query work. No new model load, output token, full q8192 timing, long-context, package, HTTP, soak or release result is claimed.
